rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that is difficult to understand.

example.jyutping: nei1 fan6 bou3 gou3 zan1 hai6 naan4 ming4

rows.note: Use this when the confusing quality comes from disorder, poor organization, or a chaotic arrangement.

example.english: The room is confusing because everything is so messy, and it is really hard to find things.
example.traditional: 間房啲嘢擺到好亂，真係好難搵嘢。
example.jyutping: gaan1 fong2 di1 je5 baai2 dou3 hou2 lyun6 zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 wan2 je5

rows.note: Use this when information, an explanation, or a distinction is unclear rather than simply difficult.

example.english: Your explanation is confusing, so I don't know what you mean.
example.traditional: 你講得唔清楚，我唔知你想點。
example.jyutping: nei5 gong2 dak1 m4 cing1 co2 ngo5 m4 zi1 nei5 soeng2 dim2
